_notes.base: Derived from strata-coder-iq1_m.json. Differences, all deliberate: --prefill 2048 instead of auto, --vram-reserve-mib 1400 added, and the TAPE env vars added.
_notes.prefill_2048: Measured on this host, same engine family: prefill 2048 drove file-backed prefill reads to 0 where auto/8192 needed 1128, at 36.20 tok/s decode versus 35.14. Strata-daedalus-v2.json leaves it on auto.
_notes.vram_reserve_1400: Held back so a second GPU consumer has room. With the reserve at 1750 the embedding model also fitted; 1400 is the value strata-daedalus-v2.json measured with.
_notes.resident_experts: Full expert arena, no --resident-budget-gib. strata-daedalus-v2.json caps at 28 GiB; the cap was rejected because a budget cap trades decode speed and buys margin that the measurements show is not needed.
_notes.tape_env: Holygoat is the commit that added the host mirror with thread-local scratch and the qsa_kv_resolve debug logging, so STRATA_KV_TAPE_HOST=1 and STRATA_KV_TAPE_DEBUG=1 are what exercise that code. The counters print to the engine's stderr, which server.py redirects into the log file above, not to the server's stdout.
_notes.hidden_flags: --vram-reserve-mib and --spec-min-p are parsed at src/program/generate.cpp:1173 and :1195 but are absent from --help. Their absence from the help text is not evidence that a config using them is invalid.
_notes.endpoint: Daedalus points at http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 with model qwen3.8-flash-next-coder-iq1_m and context_length 65536. Every strata-*.json in this repo is a port-8080 variant; only one can be served at a time.
_notes.tape_2026_10_14: Daedalus tape on holygoat: vram reserve 1400->1024 and max-context 65536->49152 give the expert cache more VRAM so the RAM complement fits (it fell 1.92 GiB short at 1400/65536); one parking slot (3072 MiB, on demand) so a side call parks main instead of evicting it; 8 checkpoints as rebase resume points; sampling = the GGUF's own (temp 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20): without it every Daedalus request decoded greedily. Backup: strata-holygoat.json.bak-20261014
_notes.tape_checkpoints: 2 checkpoints, no mid-prompt ones: root (end of system+tools, pinned) = where every rebase resumes after the middle is ejected; leaf (last turn boundary) = where the next turn appends. Parking needs >= 1.
